inheritance_policy: Public source-backed class and default interface methods instantiated with generic substitutions, excluding overrides by name/arity. Effective inherited entity fields flattened with per-field source origin. External library methods and Lombok-generated bodies are not synthesized.
entity_relationship_policy: BaseMapper/repository first generic type or TableName/Document annotation. Actual explicit entity fields form associations; scalar IDs are not guessed as foreign keys.
method_graph_policy: Maven module local/import/dependency/group resolution; declaration types, inherited generic fields, this.field, interface implementations and conservative same-class method references. Feign constants/verb/path matched. No full overload, chained return type, reflection or dynamic execution modeling.
usecase_policy: One Service-annotated class is one usecase proxy; group module is actor proxy, not hand-authored requirements.
